gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Quirky and hand-drawn, Amatic SC squeezes out thin, tubular lines with no stress in any curve, while the lowercase below stands tall. Amatic SC sketches; Noto Sans Limbu, a plain sans, speaks up.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Noto Sans Lydian keeps its capitals barely above the lowercase. Amatic SC's marker-traced lines sit on top like a rustic doodle, and the text below keeps its wide, sprung openings and settles into a quiet, approachable rhythm.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Rustic scribble meets modern order. Noto Sans Mahajani follows with tall lowercase and funnel-wide e shapes, and the single strongest quality is how loosely hand-drawn lines keep their width through every turn above something so composed.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Flat, single-weight linework, drawn like toothpaste in one steady line, is what defines Amatic SC here. And Noto Sans Malayalam fills the lines beneath with a dominant middle zone and generous s bends, so the quirky top gives way to something approachable.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Rustic and quirky, Amatic SC draws without any quill-like tapering. Its strength is casual personality, while Noto Sans Mandaic, a sans-serif with lowercase rising close to the capitals, brings the composed, businesslike texture.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Ruler-and-compass lines, but hand-sized and quirky. Noto Sans Marchen takes over below with proud small letters and curves ending in clear daylight, so the casual heading Amatic SC hands off to something clean.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-mayan-numeral: Noto Sans Mayan Numerals brings tall-bodied small letters and a visibly gaping c. Beneath Amatic SC's flat, single-weight handwriting, a larger heading size probably gives that sans-serif body its proper footing.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-medefaidrin: Tubular strokes like bent copper pipe define Amatic SC. Beside it, Noto Sans Medefaidrin, a sans with lowercase that rises high and curves that turn in without any ink pooling, feels crisp and contemporary against the rustic hand.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-meetei-mayek: Hand-lettered, one unbroken line weight from terminals to junctions, and thoroughly quirky. Noto Sans Meetei Mayek, a plain sans with gappy rounds and large lowercase eyes, grounds Amatic SC.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-mende-kikakui: Rustic and quirky, Amatic SC draws a plain, unshaded line that never swells across the top. And Noto Sans Mende Kikakui carries on with daylight in every curve and tall lowercase, so paragraphs would move along with a clean, modern briskness.
